title: white
summary: One colour, several names. Which ones share a history?
question: Are matching meanings enough?
completion: White follows Old English hwīt. German weiß is a cousin. French blanc means the same colour but follows another word family.
partner: A familiar word can carry a surprising history. Follow the evidence!
